checks.name: Auth password login and metadata cannot elevate patient role
Public specialties and approved doctor directory load
Anonymous users cannot read private tables or execute booking
Profile role/status escalation and identity changes are blocked
Booking rejects doctor role, past dates, null date, empty reason, unsupported mode and invalid availability
Available slots return actual Karachi-time schedule without private data
Authenticated RPC persists appointment, database fee, duration and notification
Other patient and unrelated doctor cannot read another appointment
Sensitive patient records remain isolated from other patients and unrelated clinicians
Duplicate booking, fee tampering and direct appointment writes are blocked
Simultaneous clients can reserve a slot only once
Occupied slots are removed from public availability
Cancellation rejects another patient and releases the owner slot
Unrelated clinicians cannot create records or conversations; forged reviews are rejected
